title: Charleston Nightmares and Nightcaps Ghost Walking Tour
includes: Stories of local hauntings and ghosts
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
All guests must be 18+ with valid ID
Not recommended for travelers with mobility issues
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your pirate guide will lead the group on a 1.5-hour walking tour through historic downtown Charleston. You will begin at a bar housed in a historic building where guests will have time to purchase and enjoy a delicious libation as the guide tells them about Charleston's fascinating haunted history. Then you will depart for a walking journey of the rest of Charleston's spooky French Quarter.

Please keep in mind that this is a walking tour! Per city law, Alcohol must NEVER be taken out of the bar.
Tour route and drink stops are subject to availability. 
All guests must be 18+ with Valid ID, and 21+ with valid ID to consume alcohol. Alcohol is NOT included.
